documents.population: First-year applicants to Yale College, including international applicants (who fulfil the same requirements as domestic applicants); Computer Science is a Yale College major
documents.notes: Yale Undergraduate Admissions 'Requirements', 'International applicants' and 'Standardized Testing' pages. Standing pages; no year is printed on the list. High school seniors also submit a Mid-Year Report with official first-marking-period grades (January or February). 'Scores from other exams, including international leaving exams or English proficiency exams will not fulfill Yale's testing requirement.' items.quote: Step 1 Complete and submit the Common Application , Coalition Application on SCOIR , or QuestBridge Application , online.
Letters of recommendation from two teachers and one counselor
Also request a letter from your school’s college counselor. If your school does not have someone serving as a college counselor, please request a recommendation from a school administrator.
Ask your counselor or other school official to submit a School Report with an official transcript that includes all completed secondary school courses
International applicants fulfill the same standardized testing requirements as domestic applicants. First-year and transfer applicants must submit scores from the SAT or ACT.

If you are a non-native English speaker without two or more years of enrollment in an English-medium school, you are required to submit scores from an English proficiency test, in addition to fulfilling Yale’s standardized testing requirement with ACT or SAT scores.
items.condition: non-native English speaker without two or more years of enrollment in an English-medium school

items.quote: If any of your documents, including transcripts and letters of recommendation, are in a language other than English, they must be accompanied by a certified translation. We are not able to accept any documents that you have translated yourself.
items.condition: documents in a language other than English
